+# hvir
+
+hvir is a desktop workbench for software development on your machine or over SSH. It brings terminals, project files, and Git into the same window so you can inspect changes without leaving your shell or coding-agent session.
+
+- **Workspaces:** Open local or remote project folders and keep terminals and files organized by project.
+- **Terminals:** Split and search Ghostty-powered terminal panes, or launch installed tools such as Claude Code and Codex with configurable profiles.
+- **Git:** Inspect working-tree changes, diffs, and commit history, and manage Git worktrees.
+- **File review:** Browse source files, preview rendered Markdown, and leave review comments on documents.
+
+## Install
+
+Download the package for your platform from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jarmak-personal/hvir/releases):
+
+| Platform | Release asset |
+| --- | --- |
+| macOS (Apple silicon) | `hvir-<version>-darwin-arm64.pkg` |
+| Debian-based Linux (x86-64) | `hvir-<version>-linux-x64.deb` |
+| Debian-based Linux (ARM64) | `hvir-<version>-linux-arm64.deb` |
+
+Open the `.pkg` on macOS, or install the `.deb` with your Linux package manager. Then launch hvir and choose a local project folder, or connect to an SSH host and choose a folder there.
+
